description: Search the 14 sanctions and export-control lists for a person or company name. Returns up to 10 listed entries, closest match first, each with an id for fetch and a link to cite. A result is name similarity, not a finding that it is the same party, and an empty result does not clear the name. Free, no account, 100 searches a day from each internet address.

query.description: A person or company name, e.g. "Acme Trading LLC". Up to 300 characters.

name: search
title: Search sanctions lists
